title: Valid Palindrome
summary: Check whether the alphanumeric characters read the same forward and backward, ignoring case.
algorithmSteps: Place one pointer at each end of the input.
Move each pointer past non-alphanumeric characters.
Compare lowercase characters and move inward until the pointers meet.

examples.input: isPalindrome("A man, a plan, a canal: Panama")
examples.explanation: Ignoring spaces, punctuation, and case produces a palindrome.

edgeCases: An empty string is a palindrome.
A string containing only punctuation is a palindrome.
